quotes.name: Austin Reaves
quotes.quote: One win is one win. I'm not going to pretend it settles anything — we're still figuring out who we are out there. But it does feel good to have something to build on, you know? The role stuff, that's a conversation that's still happening, and I'm okay with that. I'd rather earn it than have it handed to me. We've got a long season ahead, and I trust the process.
